candidates.name: Astera Labs
candidates.thesis: Rack-scale connectivity and memory-fabric expansion remain intact with no new thesis-changing primary datapoint this week.
candidates.risk: Premium valuation, hyperscaler concentration and simultaneous product-ramp execution.

candidates.name: Credo Technology
candidates.thesis: Hypergrowth, high margins and an expanding 1.6T electrical/optical connectivity stack keep Credo at the top of the discovery radar; ECOC reinforced rather than changed the thesis.
candidates.risk: Premium valuation, customer concentration and exceptionally high expectations.

candidates.name: Marvell Technology
candidates.thesis: Investor Day expanded long-term AI custom silicon and connectivity opportunity; very ambitious 2031 targets require reverse-DCF and execution checks.
candidates.risk: Hyperscaler concentration and long-dated custom-silicon expectations create execution and valuation risk.

candidates.name: Ciena
candidates.thesis: The optical-networking inflection remains supported by strong Q3 results, FY2029 targets and reported backlog visibility above $10B; analyst rerating improves capital-flow confirmation but does not alter the fundamental score.
candidates.risk: Customer concentration, supply constraints and demanding multi-year execution; valuation is increasingly sensitive to any AI optical capex normalization.

candidates.name: ASML Holding
candidates.thesis: EUV lithography monopoly and installed-base upgrades underpin a high-quality AI equipment compounder; Q3 2026 €11.7bn sales and €5.0bn net income with 2027-28 demand exceeding planned supply.
candidates.risk: Not an early-stage company; premium valuation, export controls and capacity expansion execution.

candidates.name: BE Semiconductor Industries
candidates.thesis: Q3-omsætning +113,6 % YoY, nettoresultat +323,7 % og ordreindgang +96,1 %. Hybrid-bonding-ordrer YTD over det dobbelte af hele 2025 understøtter en flerårig AI/HBM/packaging-flaskehals.
candidates.risk: Q4-omsætning ventes flad ±5 % QoQ; udrulning af hybrid bonding kan forsinkes, og halvlederudstyr er cyklisk.

candidates.name: Lumentum Holdings
candidates.thesis: Optical connectivity remains a core AI-rack bottleneck with exceptional growth, margin expansion and strong forward guidance.
candidates.risk: Extreme rerating increases valuation and drawdown risk; optical cycles can reverse sharply.

candidates.name: Synopsys
candidates.thesis: EDA and design IP toll-road with new GPT-Synopsys agentic workflows and application-optimized custom silicon IP; FY2027 guidance indicates roughly 15% growth.
candidates.risk: Premium valuation, Ansys integration and uncertain incremental AI monetization.

candidates.name: Celestica
candidates.thesis: AI-datacenter hardware og switching er stærke strukturelle vækstdrivere; Q3-regnskab og Investor Day 26.-27. oktober er nært forestående, men endnu ikke offentliggjort ved denne kørsel.
candidates.risk: Customer concentration, dilution, lower structural margins than IP businesses and execution risk.

candidates.name: Coherent Corp.
candidates.thesis: PhotonLink materially strengthens the platform thesis by integrating lasers, silicon photonics, optics, fiber, detectors, precision assembly and test into end-to-end CPO/NPO solutions for AI datacenters.
candidates.risk: High capex and optical-cycle risk; platform breadth must convert into sustained revenue and margin gains.

candidates.name: Arista Networks
candidates.thesis: AI-network demand and strong growth expectations remain intact without a thesis-changing company datapoint this week.
candidates.risk: Large-cap maturity, premium valuation and hyperscaler concentration.

candidates.name: Broadcom
candidates.thesis: AI custom silicon and networking remain an exceptional earnings engine and moat benchmark, though scale limits early-stage asymmetry.
candidates.risk: Mega-cap scale, premium expectations and customer concentration.

candidates.name: Tower Semiconductor
candidates.thesis: High-volume 800G/1.6T laser-integrated PIC shipments and a fast-growing silicon-photonics run-rate keep Tower positioned as an upstream AI-optics bottleneck.
candidates.risk: Foundry capital intensity, SiPho capacity execution, customer concentration and non-AI cyclicality.

candidates.name: Fabrinet
candidates.thesis: Advanced optical manufacturing continues benefiting directly from AI datacenter optical demand and next-generation transceiver scaling.
candidates.risk: Customer concentration and outsourced-manufacturing economics; expectations have risen substantially.

candidates.name: ASE Technology Holding
candidates.thesis: Advanced packaging and AI power delivery: unaudited Q3 2026 revenue +44.8% YoY in TWD; expanded 3D PowerSiP can cut routing losses by 50% or more under stated conditions.
candidates.risk: Capital intensity, packaging cycles and unaudited Q3 revenue ahead of full October 29 earnings.

candidates.name: Onto Innovation
candidates.thesis: AI advanced packaging, HBM and silicon photonics continue driving process-control intensity; backlog above $1B supports visibility.
candidates.risk: Semiconductor-equipment cyclicality, customer capex timing and premium expectations.

candidates.name: Soitec
candidates.thesis: Silicon-photonics substrates remain an upstream AI-optics bottleneck with multi-year customer commitments supporting visibility.
candidates.risk: Sharp rerating, cyclical non-photonics end-markets and dependence on sustained optical adoption.

candidates.name: Snowflake
candidates.thesis: Product-revenue growth has reaccelerated while AI adoption and operating leverage improve, keeping Snowflake the radar's strongest enterprise-AI software candidate.
candidates.risk: Premium valuation, stock-based compensation and consumption-model variability.

candidates.name: Lattice Semiconductor
candidates.thesis: Q2-omsætning +62 % YoY, stærke AI-server design wins og købet af AMI udvider Lattice fra low-power FPGA til firmware og sikker server management; mulig platform-compounder.
candidates.risk: Q2-tallene er fra august og ikke en ny regnskabsbekræftelse i denne uge; AMI-integration, aktieudvanding og værdiansættelse skal undersøges.

candidates.name: MaxLinear, Inc.
candidates.thesis: Q3-omsætning +72 % YoY, infrastructure +210 % og non-GAAP operating margin 29,5 % viser AI-optics DSP-rampe (Keystone) og 1.6T produktpotentiale; Q4-guidance $240-260 mio.
candidates.risk: Kursfald på ca. 18 % i ugen til 23. oktober, koncentrerede hyperscaler-programmer, konkurrence og kredit-/likviditetsrisiko. Discovery, ikke køb.
